answer.rationale: Run a small guarded onboarding-simplification test for price-sensitive SMB accounts to accelerate time-to-value and strengthen sustainable product adoption. Prior evidence supports durable activation gains from shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields. Avoid broad promotional pricing: although it lifts acquisition and qualified revenue, the recovered experiment showed a 12% decline in 30-day retention, making it unsuitable for maximizing long-term qualified revenue. Measure activation, first meaningful action, qualified revenue, and retention before scaling.
